settingsHint: Business policies, document numbers and reason codes.

groupHint.stock: How stock, counts and supplier bills are controlled.
groupHint.reminders: Chasing customers who owe you money.
groupHint.printing: Lines on receipts and invoices, and how phone numbers are read.
groupHint.alerts: When Intelligence alerts you and how daily briefs are timed.

set.negative_stock_allowed: Allow selling stock that is not there
set.payroll_unpaid_day_divisor: Days used to value unpaid leave

setHint.negative_stock_allowed: The sale still posts and an exception is raised for review.
setHint.count_variance_threshold: Stock count differences worth more than this need approval before posting.
setHint.late_posting: What happens when a document is dated in a closed accounting period.
setHint.bill_match_tolerance_percent: A bill whose cost per unit is further than this from what was ordered or received needs approval.
setHint.reminder_channel: Chase customers with overdue invoices automatically every day, or turn it off and chase by hand.
setHint.reminder_min_days_overdue: An invoice is chased once it is this many days past its due date.
setHint.reminder_repeat_days: A customer is not chased about the same invoice more often than this.
setHint.weekend_days: Leave and absence are counted without these days.
setHint.payroll_unpaid_day_divisor: A day of unpaid leave takes off basic pay divided by this number.
setHint.overtime_multiplier: Overtime is paid at this multiple of the normal hourly rate.
setHint.overtime_hours_per_month: Basic pay divided by this is the hourly rate for overtime.
setHint.phone_country_code: The calling code of your phone numbers, such as 44. National numbers are read with it.
setHint.receipt_footer: Printed at the bottom of till and payment receipts.
setHint.invoice_footer: Printed at the bottom of invoices, for example bank details or payment terms.
setHint.timezone: A name such as Europe/London or Africa/Nairobi. Daily briefs are sent at their time in this zone.
setHint.intel_alert_channel: Message the right people when Intelligence finds something serious, or keep findings in the app only.
setHint.intel_alert_min_severity: Findings at or above this severity are sent as alerts; the rest wait for the daily brief.
setHint.intel_action_level: 1 reports only. 2 also lets managers ask a person to explain a finding.

numberingHint: Every document gets the next number in its series. You can change the prefix and length; the next number can only move forward.
noSeriesHint: A series is created the first time a document of that type is made.
paddingHint: Numbers are padded with zeros to this length.
reasonsHint: Reasons people must give for voids, refunds, discounts, price changes, stock adjustments and similar actions.
codeHint: Capital letters, digits and _ only, for example DAMAGED.
label: Label
requiresNote: Require a written note when this reason is used
approvalsHint: Requests waiting for you to approve or reject. You cannot approve your own request.
noPending: Nothing is waiting for your approval.
noPendingHint: New requests appear here as soon as someone submits one that needs your role.
commentHint: Optional. The person who asked will see it.
approvalRulesHint: Who must approve what, by document type and amount.
rulesNote: When a document matches a rule, it waits for someone with the approver role. Rules in several steps are approved in order.
noRulesHint: Without rules, documents are not held for approval.
docTypeHint: The document the rule applies to, as the system names it, for example stock_adjustment.
maxAmountHint: Leave empty for no upper limit.
forbidCreatorLabel: The person who created the document may not approve it
exceptionsHint: Things the system noticed that a person should look at: odd sales, stock differences, failed messages.
noOpenExceptionsHint: New items appear here when something unusual happens.
noteRequiredHint: Say what you found or did. Required.
notificationsHint: Messages sent by email and SMS, who asked not to be contacted, and which channels are ready.
subject: Subject
noMessagesHint: Messages the system sends, such as receipts and reminders, are listed here with what became of them.
optOutsHint: People on this list are never sent messages by the system, on the channel you choose.
noOptOuts: Nobody has asked not to be contacted.
noOptOutsHint: Add a phone number or email when someone asks you to stop.
recipientHint: A phone number or an email address.
removeOptOutAsk: {{who}} may be sent messages again. Continue?
channelOffHint: Messages on this channel are not sent until it is set up.
apiKeysHint: Keys let another system talk to this business. Give each key only the access it needs.
noKeysHint: Create a key when you connect another system.
keyNameHint: What the key is for, for example Website stock sync.
scopesHint: Choose what this key may do. You can only give access you have yourself.
expiresHint: Optional. The key stops working at the end of this day.
revokeAsk: Revoke the key {{name}}? Systems using it will stop working at once. This cannot be undone.
secretWarning: Copy this key now. For your security it is shown only once and cannot be viewed again. If you lose it, revoke it and make a new one.
secretUse: Send it in the X-API-Key header of each request.
myAccountHint: Your profile, password, devices and preferences.
changePasswordHint: You will be signed out on every device and must sign in again.
passwordChanged: Password changed. Please sign in again.
devicesHint: Sign out any device you do not recognise.
noOtherDevices: You are signed in on this device only.
signOutOthersAsk: Sign out of every other device? They will need to sign in again.
